title: Exact Analytic Chowla-Selberg Derivation of Modulus Potential Ratio t_*

scope.frame: Analytic evaluation of the non-holomorphic Eisenstein series zero-mode derivatives via the Chowla-Selberg formula at y_* = sqrt(84)/3
scope.object: closed-form analytic derivation of the potential ratio t_* = 4.43001302 from leading-order 2 pi^2 / sqrt(21) and sub-leading zeta(3), zeta(5) reflection terms, eliminating t_* as a numerical fit (P-401)
scope.hypotheses: Modular apex y_* = sqrt(84)/3; Chowla-Selberg Fourier expansion of E(tau, 3) and E(tau, 2)

claim_one_line: ANALYTIC CHOWLA-SELBERG DERIVATION OF T_* (P-401): derived the closed-form analytic formula for the modulus potential ratio t_* = [(2 pi^6/315) y_*^2 - (3 pi/2) zeta(5) y_*^-3] / [(2 pi^4/45) y_* - pi zeta(3) y_*^-2] = 4.43001302 at y_* = sqrt(84)/3, proving that leading order is exactly 2 pi^2 / sqrt(21) = 4.307448 with +2.77% shift from zeta(3) and zeta(5), eliminating t_* as an empirical parameter.
weave_or_thread: weave (exact analytic Chowla-Selberg derivation of modulus potential ratio)
